clusterConfig.restartHint: Sync switches and poll interval take effect immediately after saving; changing the replica count requires restarting replicas.
clusterConfig.loadFailed: Failed to read cluster settings. Check whether the backend is reachable.
clusterConfig.membersEmpty: No replica has reported yet. This stays empty on standalone deployments; on cluster deployments, check Redis and the member heartbeat configuration.
clusterConfig.modeDescCluster: Multiple replicas detected: saved configuration is propagated to other replicas through version polling and the event bus, without restarting each replica.
clusterConfig.modeDescStandalone: Standalone deployment: configuration sync brings no benefit, keep the defaults. Multi-replica deployments switch to cluster mode automatically.
clusterConfig.syncDesc: Other replicas detect configuration changes by polling the version number and rebuild their service and instance registry; when the Redis event bus is available they are also notified right after a save.
clusterConfig.eventBusHint: When the event bus is unavailable it degrades to pure polling automatically. Correctness is unaffected, only propagation latency grows.
clusterConfig.syncDisabledHint: Disabled: this replica no longer discovers configuration changes from other replicas; only a restart or a manual refresh will sync it.
clusterConfig.appliedVersion: Applied on this replica: config v{config} / API Key v{apiKey}
clusterConfig.healthDesc: By default each replica probes upstream instances on its own. With sharing enabled, this replica may trust health reports from other replicas, so a momentary probe failure on one replica no longer takes an instance out of rotation.
clusterConfig.healthModeHint: local = use this replica's probe result only; shared = healthy if any replica reports healthy; quorum = local healthy passes immediately, otherwise the number of healthy replicas in the shared view must reach the tolerance count.
clusterConfig.healthStandaloneHint: Currently a standalone deployment; health sharing stays inactive until running as a cluster.
clusterConfig.saved: Saved. Later configuration changes will propagate to other replicas
